description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReport' implements the 'EndpointAwareReport' interface for generating employee reports within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for preparing filter parameters, defining validation rules, checking report access permissions, and providing report header and filter definitions. The class utilizes traits for user role management and internationalization support, and interacts with various entities and API components to facilitate report generation.

classes.name: EmployeeReport
classes.description: Implements the report generation logic for employee time reports in OrangeHRM, including filter preparation, validation, permission checks, and report header/filter definitions.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters for the report based on request query parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for incoming request parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report data.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header columns configuration.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on filter parameters.
